full_name: Anne M. Robertson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Anne M. Robertson is an engineer whose research interests lie in the multidisciplinary study of the relationship between the physical structure of such soft tissue organs as arteries and the bladder and their mechanical functions.
